    Interface SimplifyOptions

    Options for Emap.simplifyLayer. Exactly one of percentage, interval, or resolution MUST be supplied — they correspond to mapshaper's three threshold modes and are mutually exclusive.

    Example

    Runnable example association: buffer, check-geometry, clip-erase.

    interface SimplifyOptions {
        interval?: number;
        keepShapes?: boolean;
        lockBox?: boolean;
        method?: SimplifyMethod;
        noRepair?: boolean;
        percentage?: number;
        planar?: boolean;
        resolution?: string;
        source: string;
        target?: string;
        weighting?: number;
    }
